Definition: Shimri, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shimri = "vigilant"; 1) a Simeonite, son of Shemaiah and father of Jedaiah; 2) father of Jediael, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) a Merarite Levite, son of Hosah; 4) a Kohathite Levite of the sons of Elizaphan
